definition: When the reference labels cover only part of what is actually present, so a model that is right about an unlabelled case is scored as wrong. Both sources treat it as a measurement problem to be quantified rather than a caveat to be mentioned. The protein-probing work supplies the cleanest demonstration: identical activations decode the same concept at F1 0.85 against dense structural labels and 0.42 against sparse experimental annotations, and a self-consistency check that recomputes the dense labels on the model's own predicted structure moves the score by only 0.06 to 0.08 -- ruling out structural disagreement and establishing the gap as missing labels, so every score against the sparse set is a lower bound. The skill-retrieval work addresses the same problem on the evaluation side, where a benchmark assigns one official target per query although a large corpus may hold several functionally substitutable answers; it responds with a sensitivity analysis crediting independently reviewed alternatives, which moves every retriever by a comparable margin (+1.37 to +3.54 Recall@1) and leaves the ordering intact. Together the sources give both the diagnosis and the two available responses -- measure the gap against a denser label set, or measure how much crediting the missing positives would move the ranking -- and the shared conclusion is that cross-paper comparisons are only meaningful at matched label density.

evidence.note: Uses chain-of-thought about required capabilities as training-time supervision for a skill retriever -- distilled from a teacher in stage one and refined by retrieval-rewarded GRPO in stage two -- so that at inference the model encodes the bare query with no generation at all.
evidence.title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests

evidence.note: Probes and steers across the trunk-to-diffusion boundary of an AlphaFold3-class structure predictor, finding that geometry survives the crossing while sequence chemistry is attenuated, and that a strand direction predictive at F1 0.82 steers nothing at all -- with an architectural explanation for why.
evidence.title: Probing and steering biology across Boltz-1s trunk-diffusion boundary

name: annotation incompleteness
